description: This is a C# source code file defining internal helper functions for the PDFsharp library, including diagnostics, logging, debug utilities, and font development helpers.

classes.name: DiagnosticsHelper
classes.description: Contains internal helper functions for handling not implemented features, exceptions, and logging behaviors.

classes.name: DebugBreak
classes.description: Provides a utility method to trigger a debugger break if attached or if forced.

classes.name: FontsDevHelper
classes.description: Offers font creation, caching state dumping, and typeface property extraction utilities for development purposes.

methods.name: HandleNotImplemented
methods.description: Handles unimplemented feature scenarios based on specified behaviors, such as logging or throwing exceptions.

methods.name: ThrowNotImplementedException
methods.description: Indicates a feature is not implemented by throwing a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: ThrowNotSupportedException
methods.description: Throws a NotSupportedException with the provided message.

methods.name: Break
methods.description: Triggers a debugging break if a debugger is attached or if forced.

methods.name: CreateSpecialFont
methods.description: Creates a font with optional simulation for bold/italic styles.

methods.name: GetFontCachesState
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current state of font caches.

methods.name: TryGetStretchAndWeight
methods.description: Gets stretch and weight information from a glyph typeface.
